About

Dr. Arun Sharma

"Not in the Frame" means this: the frame holds only the news. The reporters, camera operators, drivers and crews who bring it to us are not in it. Nor are the anchors and readers who present it, explain it and analyse it, because they are not the news either. Their own stories rarely make it into the frame.

Beyond the headlines and the faces we see every evening, there are journeys, experiences, challenges and human stories that never reach the screen.

The book is currently in progress, beginning with conversations with the people who have been there: behind the camera, behind the desk, and beyond what we see on screen.
